lines: I'll go ahead and gift you some influence. Influence, you could say, will be your currency.
Alright, now use your influence to purchase a tome from my inventory.
Well done! Influence is important because that defines how the realm views us.
By giving me the influence you earn, I'll continue to make you stronger.
Tomes can be very powerful for they summon all manner of creatures.
With each tome you purchase, you trigger an incantation that tames creatures over time.
Now, you are going to want to also cast some spells yourself.
I'm going to send you to the outlook.
Come back and see me after you have gathered enough influence and reached a high enough level.
